decisions.why: examples (shower seats, grab rails/bars) are bathing aids - directly matches Bathing and toileting aids
examples are rise-and-recline chairs and footstools - specialist seating for people with reduced mobility
examples (commode bucket, commode liners, portable urinal, mobile commode) are toileting aids, which the Bathing and toileting aids type explicitly covers
examples are walking frames and travel walkers - core walking aids
examples are ergonomic and collapsible walking sticks - walking aids
examples (V pillow, coccyx wedge cushions) are pressure-relieving seat cushions, matching Pressure-relieving cushions
examples are self-propelled and transit wheelchairs - matches Wheelchairs and specialist seating
examples (curved rail, grab bar) are bathroom/toilet safety grab rails, covered by Bathing and toileting aids
examples (patient turner belts, swivel patient turner, transfer aids) are patient transfer/turning aids, closest fit to Slide sheets and transfer boards
